title: resend_raw input
description: Input schema for the resend_raw tool (RFC-001 N8 typed raw resend).

flow_id.description: Recorded raw stream id. REQUIRED — resend_raw has no from-scratch path.

target_addr.description: Upstream host:port. REQUIRED. Explicit port required (no defaulting).

use_tls.description: True to upgrade the dialed connection to TLS via tlslayer.Client.

sni.description: SNI server name; defaults to target_addr host portion when use_tls=true.

override_bytes.description: Replacement payload interpreted per override_bytes_encoding; mutually exclusive with patches.

override_bytes_encoding.description: Encoding for override_bytes. Default text. base64 required for binary smuggling payloads.

override_bytes_set.description: Set true to replace with empty bytes; otherwise an empty override_bytes string is treated as no override.

patches.description: Offset-based byte patches applied to the recovered bytes; mutually exclusive with override_bytes.

offset.description: Zero-based byte offset in the recovered payload.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS server certificate verification when use_tls=true.

tag.description: Tag stored on the new flow's Tags map.
